meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Refactor existing code without changing behavior. Use when the user wants to improve readability, modularity, performance, type safety, or reduce duplication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构现有代码，提升可读性和模块化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要改善代码结构而不改变功能
copy.tagline_en: Refactor existing code to improve readability and modularity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to improve code structure without changing behavior

howto.what: 当您要求重构代码时，Claude 会遵循一个严谨流程：先确认重构目标和不变项（如行为、API），然后逐步修改，每步确保测试通过，最后验证没有改变外部行为。它一次只改进一个方面，比如可读性或性能。
howto.when: 当您想改进代码的可读性、模块化、性能、类型安全或减少重复时，可以直接提出重构要求。Claude 会在您给出具体代码后启动重构过程。

say.text: 把这段JavaScript代码重构得更易读。
say.note: Claude 会按可读性维度重构

say.text: 优化这个函数的性能，但保持行为不变。
say.note: Claude 会专注于性能维度

say.text: 重构这个模块，消除重复代码。

howto.what_en: When asked to refactor code, Claude follows a disciplined process: confirm the invariant and dimension, load context, outline a plan, execute one step at a time with tests passing, and verify no behavioral change. It only addresses one improvement axis (e.g., readability, performance).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to improve readability, modularity, performance, type safety, or reduce duplication in existing code, and explicitly requests a refactor. It starts after the user provides the code.

say_en.text: Refactor this JavaScript code to be more readable.
Optimize this function for performance without changing behavior.
Refactor this module to eliminate duplicated code.
